scope: Manual source audit of recorded training native key/value/strength mutation paths; source-bound, not a general static analyzer

mutation_sites.source: journal_store(Values + (n * S + allocation) * DV + d, gate * content, d < DV, J, RecordAll, Values + (n * S + allocation) * DV + 0, DV, CaptureScratch+n*tl.maximum(S,DV))
journal_store(Values + (n * S + safe_target) * DV + d, prev + beta * (content - prev), d < DV, J, RecordAll, Values + (n * S + safe_target) * DV + 0, DV, CaptureScratch+n*tl.maximum(S,DV))
journal_store(Strength + n * S + dead, death_strength, True, J, RecordAll)

notes: Allocation key/value, correction value, pop/allocation/death/final-materialization strength use journal_store at all seven mutation sites.
No direct tl.store of native Keys/Values/Strength in scan_kernel or materialize_state; metadata initialization and read/version scratch are separate buffers.
Training Replay.forward always calls record_all=True. Inference with recording disabled intentionally has no all-field journal and is excluded.
Fresh torch/fused initialization sets payload/strength to +0; imported states are outside the new long-pool branch.
Fresh corrections target adjacent live rows already in the allocation union. Current live occupancy is never substituted for this union.
Scalar journal_store omits bit-identical writes, which cannot introduce a nonzero value into an untouched zero slot.
The union is a conservative support envelope, not equality with current live occupancy or numerically nonzero adjoints.
80 B32 fixtures verify actual journal-address coverage and complete payload/strength rollback.
